import hashlib
import json
import sys

SRC = sys.argv[1]
DST = sys.argv[2]

KEEP_OPS = {
    "discover-0001",  # each refund has at most one amount
    "discover-0003",  # each refund is paid by at most one channel
    "discover-0004",  # every refund is requested by a customer
    "discover-0006",  # every refund is for an amount
    "discover-0008",  # every refund is paid by a channel
}

DROP_CONSTRAINTS = {
    ("refund_by", "uniqueness", "customer"),
    ("refund_by", "mandatory", "customer"),
    ("refund_amount", "uniqueness", "amount"),
    ("refund_amount", "mandatory", "amount"),
    ("refund_channel", "mandatory", "channel"),
}

with open(SRC, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    proposal = json.load(fh)

text = proposal["candidate_model"]["text"]
original_digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
model = json.loads(text)
reserialized = json.dumps(model, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
print("round-trip matches original text:", reserialized == text)
print("original candidate sha256 matches:", original_digest == proposal["candidate_model"]["sha256"])

dropped = []
for fact_type in model["fact_types"]:
    kept = []
    for constraint in fact_type["constraints"]:
        if "provenance" not in constraint or constraint.get("source") != "induced":
            kept.append(constraint)
            continue
        role = constraint.get("roles", [None])[0] if "roles" in constraint else constraint.get("role")
        key = (fact_type["id"], constraint["type"], role)
        if key in DROP_CONSTRAINTS:
            dropped.append(key)
        else:
            kept.append(constraint)
    fact_type["constraints"] = kept

new_text = json.dumps(model, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
new_digest = hashlib.sha256(new_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("dropped from candidate:", len(dropped), sorted(dropped))

proposal["candidate_model"]["text"] = new_text
proposal["candidate_model"]["sha256"] = new_digest
proposal["operations"] = [op for op in proposal["operations"] if op["operation_id"] in KEEP_OPS]
proposal["rationale"] = "gnd discover, refund-level subset of 10 candidates observed in south.yaml (customer-level and amount-level candidates dropped by owner choice)"

with open(DST, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    json.dump(proposal, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    fh.write("\n")

print("kept operations:", [op["operation_id"] for op in proposal["operations"]])
print("new candidate sha256:", new_digest)
